explanation: NOT EXISTS looks, for each Earbuds product, for any product that names it as its sister. NOT IN compares with a list that holds missing values, so it keeps no product at all. Without the outer alias p, the inner test compares each product s with itself and finds no match, so every Earbuds product is kept. In the LEFT JOIN, the test on s.category_id in WHERE throws away exactly the unmatched rows the IS NULL test was looking for.
